subject: Consolidated monthly settlement, PO line visibility & conditional discount
messages:
From: Emma Keller <emma.keller@deltabridge.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@deltabridge.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated monthly settlements / PO mapping / discount tiers

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at DeltaBridge is preparing the SOW/PO paperwork and we need to align on three items before we can issue a blanket PO: 1) how you want invoices delivered for a consolidated monthly statement, 2) whether each invoice must include our PO line references per our ERP (we can provide a CSV template), and 3) whether a contract-level discount can be applied conditioned on year-long commit and quarterly true-ups.

Specifically:
- We require a single consolidated invoice each month (PDF) with a breakdown by PO line (ERP code + description + amount).
- Our AP team needs the PO number on every invoice line to auto-match.
- Standard net terms for our vendors are Net45; we can discuss Net30 for strategic vendors but need a discount to justify shorter terms.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Send a single monthly PDF bundle to a secure SFTP or email account;
- Put our PO line codes on every invoice line; and
- Provide a negotiated commercial discount (example: X% off list) if we commit to 12- or 24-month spend and accept quarterly reconciliation?

I'll attach a sample PO template (CSV) and our vendor onboarding checklist. If you can share a sample consolidated invoice and a proposed discount grid, I can expedite approval.

Best,
Emma Keller
Sr. Procurement Manager
DeltaBridge Systems
Attachments: DeltaBridge_PO_Template.csv, DBS_vendor_onboarding.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Keller <emma.keller@deltabridge.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@deltabridge.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated monthly settlements / PO mapping / discount tiers

Emma —

Thanks for the clear list. Yes, we can support the workflow you described. Quick summary and proposed commercial terms below.

Operational / invoicing:
- Delivery: We can push a consolidated PDF invoice bundle to SFTP, or to a dedicated AP email (SFTP preferred for security). We will include a cover sheet with month totals and a line-by-line CSV export for easy ERP ingestion.
- PO lines: We will populate your PO number and ERP line code on every invoice line; please confirm the exact CSV field name for the ERP code (we used "cost_center_code" previously).
- Cutoff: We propose a billing cutoff of the 25th of the month for that month's consolidated invoice (gives us time to reconcile usage). If you need month-end cutoff instead, we can discuss implications for timing and lead time.

Commercial (conditional discount grid):
- 12-month financial commitment: 4% off list for committed baseline usage + quarterly true-up (overages billed at list).
- 24-month financial commitment: 7% off list for committed baseline usage + quarterly true-up.
- Shorter-term (12 months) with Net30: additional 1% credit applied as an early payment incentive (applies only if invoices are paid within Net30).

Notes: discounts are applied to recurring service spend (tokens/instances) not to one-time professional services. Any quarterly true-up that exceeds the committed baseline is billed at standard rate; under-utilization is credited at the same discounted rate on the following invoice.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm the ERP field name(s) and preferred SFTP endpoint or AP email;
2) Vivek will confirm the acceptable net terms and remittance details from Redwood's finance side;
3) We can draft a short pricing addendum (1 page) to be signed via DocuSign covering the discount grid and billing cadence.

Attached: Sample_Consolidated_Invoice_Redwood_202609.pdf, Pricing_Addendum_Draft.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min sync if you want to walk through the CSV mapping.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Emma Keller <emma.keller@deltabridge.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@deltabridge.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Consolidated monthly settlements / PO mapping / discount tiers

Rafael / Emma —

Quick finance note from our side:
- Net terms: Redwood standard is Net30. We can agree to Net45 only if the contract includes the 7% (24-month) commitment or a prepay arrangement. If DeltaBridge needs Net45 as a hard requirement, we will need a slight adjustment to the discount grid (propose 3% for 12-month, 5% for 24-month) — happy to keep the commercial thread flexible while Rafael and Emma finalize.
- Remittance: Please add DeltaBridge's remit and tax id to the PO template. For Redwood, we will accept ACH, wire, or check (ACH preferred). I will add remittance instructions to the pricing addendum.
- Cutoff date: 25th of the month is workable; will need to lock in a transaction window for usage reporting (we publish usage by the 22nd in most cases).

If you confirm the SFTP endpoint and ERP column mapping today we can produce a first-month sample bundle for your AP to test.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Emma Keller <emma.keller@deltabridge.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@deltabridge.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated monthly settlements / PO mapping / discount tiers

Rafael / Vivek —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. DeltaBridge is comfortable to proceed on the following conditional terms:
- We will issue a blanket PO effective 1 Oct 2026 with a 12-month baseline commit subject to quarterly true-ups.
- We accept the 4% discount for 12 months provided Net45 is accepted (DeltaBridge standard). If Redwood can agree to a 1% early-payment credit for Net30 payment, we will include language to enable fast payment where business units choose to pay earlier.
- Please send a redlined pricing addendum (DocuSign link) and a sample consolidated invoice CSV mapping by end of day Monday so our AP team can test ingestion.

I attach the filled PO template with our ERP column names and remit address.

Emma Keller
Sr. Procurement Manager
DeltaBridge Systems
Attachments: DeltaBridge_PO_Template.csv (filled)
